verdict.rationale: Inngest has a few product-native pieces that point toward isolated testing: users praise its development server and local mode, its REST API exposes 'environments', and its testing library mocks function state and inputs. The mocking library is mock-based testing rather than a sandboxed environment, and no first-party doc describes an isolated sandbox or branch environment that is separated from production data. missing for 10: first-party documentation of sandbox/branch/staging environments, explicit statement that production data is isolated, documented dev-server sandbox workflow, hands-on corroboration of environment isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The development server is neat and makes debugging jobs very easy.
interact with events, function runs, environments, and more programmatically
mock function state, step tooling, and inputs with a Jest-compatible API
